summary: Rabbi Harari discusses whether a mourner is permitted to perform the mitzvah of Shnayim Mikra ve-Echad Targum during the seven days of shiv'ah. He examines the conflicting opinions among authorities regarding whether this practice is restricted to Shabbat or permitted throughout the week, based on the legal precedent of Kiryat Shema.
questions: Is a mourner allowed to perform Shnayim Mikra during shiv'ah?
Does the prohibition of Talmud Torah for a mourner apply to Shnayim Mikra?
Is Shnayim Mikra permitted only on Shabbat for a mourner?
What is the significance of the comparison to Kiryat Shema in this context?
